request.description: Checks a condition against the live dictionary without running it: unknown attributes, operators that do not fit the attribute type, wrong value types, unknown enum values and size limits. Use before saving lender rules, question visibility or routing rules. A condition is a tree of `all` / `any` / `not` groups over leaves `{attr, op, value?, pass?, fail?}`. Operators: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not_in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `between` (`{min, max}`), `exists`, `not_exists`, `contains`, `matches`. Limits: depth 10, 200 leaves, 500 list items, 200-character patterns.
